title: LDAP Authentication
description: Enables user authentication against any LDAP directory.

settings_def.name: account_filter
settings_def.label: Account Filter Format
settings_def.description: You can specify an account filter format here. You can leave this field blank to use the default account filter format, which is: (|(dn=%s)(mail=%s)(uid=%s))

settings_def.name: auto_agent
settings_def.label: Auto Agent
settings_def.checkbox_label: Automatically create agents if they do not already exist

settings_def.name: sync_enabled
settings_def.label: Enable Auto Sync
settings_def.checkbox_label: Routinely sync user information from this usersource to Deskpro

settings_def.name: ldap_paging
settings_def.label: Enable LDAP Paging
settings_def.description: By default, our sync system does not use LDAP Paging. If your LDAP server supports LDAP paging, you can enable it here.

settings_def.name: ldap_per_page
settings_def.label: LDAP Size Limit
settings_def.description: LDAP servers typically set a limit on the number of entries that we can query for during a sync. For no limit, enter 0. If you are not sure, please check with your LDAP server administrator.

settings_def.name: raw_info_filter
settings_def.label: Filter
settings_def.description: You can filter based on info provided by the usersource. Learn about this feature
